issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the problem statement UML and the solution repository declare a single-parameter method findStockIngredient(String name) that returns a StockIngredient, but the template repository declares findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) (an extra boolean parameter). This mismatch will cause compilation errors or broken calls in code that expects findStockIngredient(String) (for example, SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery and SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice in the solution call findStockIngredient(name) with one argument), and will confuse students implementing the exercise because the API in the template does not match the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template API with the problem statement and solution by changing the template's Stock.findStockIngredient signature to public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name). If case-sensitivity control is desired for exercises, add an overloaded method public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) that delegates to the single-parameter implementation, or implement case handling internally so all existing one-argument call sites compile and behave as described.
